scope: Administrative Git/PCC reconciliation; scientific sources/results unchanged.
statement: Shared metadata merge preserves the entire original branch/main/common ledgers and journals in an extracted and deterministically repacked whole archive, keeps actual main ledger byte prefix, and re-registers five immutable unsigned claim subjects through the maintained PCC API.
